# Oeste

A component reference for humans, AI agents, and vibe coders.
Oeste — Three libraries. Three lenses. Each library is complete: Human docs, Agent contracts (oeste.component.v1), Vibe code (shadcn registry + copy-paste).

## Libraries

- Topanga (v0.4.8, 34 components) — The debut library. Warm paper, canyon clay, ochre, sagebrush, precision hairlines. Light + dark.
  Docs: https://oeste.hiddeninwest.com/topanga/ — llms.txt: /topanga/llms.txt — manifest: /topanga/components.json — registry: /topanga/r/
  Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://oeste.hiddeninwest.com/topanga/r/button.json`
- Huntington (v0.2.0, 45 components) — A single-column library. Five moods: Paper, Ink, Rose, Sage, Dune. Hairlines instead of shadows, no filled button.
  Docs: https://oeste.hiddeninwest.com/huntington/ — llms.txt: /huntington/llms.txt — manifest: /huntington/components.json — registry: /huntington/r/
  Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://oeste.hiddeninwest.com/huntington/r/header.json`
- Mesa (v0.2.0, 73 components) — Warm paper, near-black ink, oxblood for status. Dark by default. Hairlines and double rules.
  Docs: https://oeste.hiddeninwest.com/mesa/ — llms.txt: /mesa/llms.txt — manifest: /mesa/components.json — registry: /mesa/r/
  Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://oeste.hiddeninwest.com/mesa/r/button.json`

## Backwards compatibility

- /r/* redirects to /topanga/r/* (Topanga's registry kept its old address working).
- /components.json redirects to /topanga/components.json.
- Old Topanga deep links (oeste.hiddeninwest.com/#/...) redirect to /topanga/#/...
- Old Topanga asset paths /src/* and /site/* redirect to /topanga/src/* and /topanga/site/*.

## For agents

- Start from the library's own llms.txt (linked above), not this index. Each library's llms.txt is its contract.
- Tokens live in <library>/src/tokens.css + <library>/src/tokens.json. Never mix tokens across libraries.
